answer: Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 7 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in zephyr and lantern lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the tide graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1150 impostors cost 1478 times the honest price and take 13 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
